$comment: Field definitions for the ARA plant location layers (ARA_loc_<year>).

fields.name: ARA_Nr
fields.title: Plant number
fields.description: Identification number of the treatment plant. Joins to the catchment and discharge layers of the same year.

fields.name: Kanton
fields.title: Canton
fields.description: Canton in which the plant is located, as the two-letter abbreviation.

fields.name: m_ueber_Meer
fields.title: Elevation
fields.description: Elevation of the plant building, not of the catchment. The vertical datum is not yet recorded; see eawag:pending. Swiss elevations are either LN02 or LHN95 and the two differ by up to roughly 0.5 m, so this value should not be used for anything datum-sensitive until confirmed.

fields.name: Bezeichnung
fields.title: Responsible body
fields.description: Body responsible for the plant, such as a municipality or an operating organisation. Names organisations, not individuals.

fields.name: erhebungsjahr
fields.title: Survey year
fields.description: Year in which the plant record was surveyed, as adapted during compilation.

eawag:pending: Record the vertical datum for m_ueber_Meer: LN02 or LHN95.
Confirm the missing-value convention actually used in the files, then add a missingValues array to this schema.
Confirm any remaining columns, including those shared with the catchment layer.
